title: A bill to amend title XI of the Social Security Act to clarify waiver authority regarding programs of all-inclusive care for the elderly (PACE programs).
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was reported to the Senate on July 30, 2015. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This bill amends part A (General Provisions) of title XI of the Social Security Act to authorize the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to waive applicable general and Medicaid requirements of the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) in order to conduct demonstration projects through the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMS Innovation Center) that involve PACE.

HHS may not, as part of a CMS Innovation Center demonstration, waive: (1) the requirement to offer items and services under Medicare and Medicaid without limitation to PACE program enrollees, and (2) certain requirements regarding enrollment in and disenrollment from PACE programs.

summary.headline: This law lets HHS waive some PACE program rules when testing new payment or care models through the CMS Innovation Center.
summary.what_it_does: PACE is a program that gives older adults coordinated care, often combining medical, social, and daily living services. This law allows the Department of Health and Human Services to waive certain general and Medicaid rules for PACE when it runs demonstration projects through the CMS Innovation Center. The law also keeps some protections in place: HHS cannot waive the requirement that PACE enrollees receive Medicare and Medicaid items and services without limitation, or certain rules about enrolling in and leaving PACE.

who_it_affects.group: Older adults enrolled in PACE programs
who_it_affects.how: Their guaranteed access to Medicare and Medicaid items and services, and the rules on joining or leaving PACE, cannot be waived under these demonstrations.
They may take part in or be affected by CMS Innovation Center demonstration projects where certain PACE rules are waived.

who_it_affects.group: Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries who could join demonstrations
who_it_affects.how: Some may be enrolled in test projects that change how PACE care is delivered or paid for.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Upon enactment on November 5, 2015, with the waiver authority available to HHS from that date.
